bio: Benjamin Michael McAdams (born December 5, 1974) is an American politician and attorney who is the United States representative-elect from Utah's 1st congressional district. He previously served as the U.S. representative from Utah's 4th congressional district from 2019 to 2021. McAdams was the Democratic nominee for Utah's 1st congressional district for the 2026 election, defeating Republican nominee Riley Owen.
offices: Member of the State Senate of Utah (2009–2012)
